description: This Java class defines the entity 'ShoppingCartAttributeItem', representing an item with product attributes in a shopping cart system. It includes fields for IDs, relationships to shopping cart items, product attributes, and auditing information, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: ShoppingCartAttributeItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an item with product attribute in the shopping cart, including audit info and relationships to product attributes and shopping cart items.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Returns the shopping cart item associated with this attribute item.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Sets the shopping cart item associated with this attribute item.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section for tracking creation/modification info.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for this entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this attribute item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this attribute item.
